seo.hook: HID-Fi is open-source firmware for a small ESP32-S3 board. Flash it, plug the board into any computer over USB-C, and your phone becomes its keyboard and mouse — no drivers, no app, no admin rights on that machine.
seo.description: HID-Fi turns a small ESP32-S3 board into a USB keyboard and mouse you drive from your phone over the board's own Wi-Fi: trackpad, full keyboard, password vault, hundreds of shortcuts, media knobs, and lock/unlock. Full build and flashing guide on the channel.

scenes.narration: HID-Fi turns your phone into the keyboard and mouse for any computer.
The HID-Fi dashboard runs in a phone's browser, and every swipe you make on that trackpad moves the cursor on the computer, straight away. A tap clicks, exactly like a trackpad would.

scenes.narration: Here's how. HID-Fi is firmware you flash onto a small ESP32-S3 board. Plug that board into any computer over USB-C, and that computer just sees an ordinary keyboard and mouse — no driver, no app, no admin rights. Your phone drives the board over its own Wi-Fi, so every touch lands as a click or a keystroke.
So you get a full keyboard, a password vault, hundreds of shortcuts and media knobs — handy when you forgot your mouse, when the trackpad dies, or when the computer is across the room.
